product_name: ST08 Portable Digital Tire Inflator 150 PSI
product_name_cn: 车载便携数显充气泵 150 PSI

specifications.continuous_runtime: 5-20 minutes (15 min cooldown after 15 min use)

key_features: 150 PSI max pressure — inflates 195/65R15 car tire from 0 to 35 PSI in ~5 minutes
Programmable auto-shutoff — set target pressure, device stops automatically
Digital LED display with ±1.5 PSI precision, switchable units (PSI/BAR/KG/CM²)
Built-in LED work light for nighttime tire changes
4 nozzles + 1 spare fuse — covers car, motorcycle, bike, basketball, sports equipment
3.5m long power cable — reaches all 4 tires without repositioning
Foldable handle — compact storage in trunk
accessories_in_box: 4 × inflation nozzles (car valve, motorcycle valve, Presta/ball needle, inflation tip)
target_audience: Parents needing to inflate kids' bikes and sports balls
Gift buyers looking for practical presents
pain_points_solved: Roadside flat tire emergency, no gas station nearby
Low tire pressure in cold weather (common daily issue)
Multiple devices needed for car + bike + ball — replaced by one
Dark/night tire changes with no work light
Analog gauge inaccuracy — digital precision instead
Short cable can't reach all 4 tires — 3.5m solves it
unique_selling_points: 150 PSI max (higher than most consumer inflators ~100 PSI)
LED work light integrated (rare at this price point)
3.5m cable reaches all 4 tires without moving the unit
safety_notes: Do not run continuously for more than 15 minutes; allow 15 min cooldown
Always set target pressure above current tire pressure
Monitor the device during inflation; do not leave unattended
